attchmntText: R.P.P. Infra Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: R.P.P Infra Projects Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 at a Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Company reported a Net Profit of 2.56 Crore for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 15.09 Crore in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the Net Profit was 5.34 Crore, down from 25.95 Crore in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 336.94 Crore for the quarter and 684.03 Crore for the half year. The results have been disseminated on the Company’s website and in newspapers. Copies of the financial results and the Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditors are enclosed with the announcement.
